summary: A1 triage of the two manual anchors on filler rows (eps 2, 18). Both are genuine filler bodies with 2-3 page grafts, NOT mistyped rows: Hunterpedia's infobox reads Adapted=Filler / Adapted 2=Chapter 1 (p. 31-32) for ep 2 (port-town fake-Hunter plot; the wiki's prose adds 'the events of this episode did not occur in the manga' - only Gon and Leorio boarding the Kaijinmaru is manga) and Adapted=Filler / Adapted 2=Chapter 7 (p. 9-11) for ep 18 (island-hotel treasure plot; the graft is Kurapika's Phantom Troupe/Scarlet-Eyes reveal relocated from the Phase 1 tunnel run). AFL independently types both pure Filler (its pure-filler set: 2, 7, 18-20) while deliberately using its Mixed label elsewhere (4-6, 11-12, 26-27, 32-34, 46), so the filler typing is intentional in both source families. These anchors are batch15's 'sliver anchors', explicitly flagged then as a sliver-vs-annotation call; Sean's 2026-08-24 sliver ruling (<=~5 pages -> annotation facts only) settles it: null both. The stored batch14/15 graft annotations already carry the exact page facts, so no new annotations are needed. If ep 18 still carries batch15's continue point (-> ch 23), remove it with the anchor.

A <=5-page graft is annotation-fact material only; the stored graft annotation already records it. Manual-source anchor, no re-derive risk.
